verdict.rationale: Devin documents running without a human at the keyboard. The Devin API exists to "integrate Devin into your applications, automate workflows" and can create sessions on behalf of users. The docs also cover integrating Devin into CI/CD pipelines to respond to static-analysis findings, and Auto-Fix iterates on CI failures "without you in the loop." Cloud sessions run on their own VMs and keep going after you disconnect, and the CLI accepts a prompt directly. missing for 10: an explicit documented headless/non-interactive CLI mode (flags, exit codes, output formats), concrete CI configuration examples (e.g. a GitHub Actions workflow), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
